summary: A dropdown menu you click to choose one option from a list.
description: A select dropdown whose options are provided as moz-option light-DOM children. Renders a native <select> when no options have icons, or a panel-list/button combo when at least one moz-option has an icon.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The text of the label element.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The select size. Options: default, small.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the input control.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the selected option.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: The disabled state of the input control.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Text for the description element that helps describe the input control.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Name of the SUMO support page to link to.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: The aria-label text when there is no visible label.

attributes.name: ariaDescription
attributes.description: The aria-description text when there is no visible description.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title attribute, mapped onto the inner control.

attributes.name: options
attributes.description: Internal reactive state (state: true, not reflected): array of options read from <moz-option> children.

attributes.name: selectedOption
attributes.description: Internal reactive state (state: true, not reflected): the currently selected option object.

attributes.name: selectedIndex
attributes.description: Internal reactive state (state: true, not reflected): index of the currently selected option.

attributes.name: usePanelList
attributes.description: Internal reactive state (state: true, not reflected): whether to render the panel-list/button combo instead of a native <select>, true when at least one option has an icon.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: moz-option (and <hr> separator) children that populate the select's options. Read via MutationObserver, not meant to be styled directly.

events.name: change
events.description: Redispatched when the selected value changes, whether via the native <select> or the panel-list path.

usage:
<moz-select label="Search engine" name="search-engine" value="option1">
  <moz-option value="option1" label="Option 1"></moz-option>
  <moz-option value="option2" label="Option 2"></moz-option>
</moz-select>
